common_instruction: 与条件から答えに至る数学的な根拠を示してください。解決の核心となる関係も論証し、既知の点の名称や性質への言及だけで済ませないでください。座標による解法も使用できます。最終的な数値を \boxed{...} に入れてください。
decision_reference: Prior proposal: roughly 8 complete useful-construction examples across ~4 structural families would justify considering learning; not a statistical power criterion.
exploration_instruction: 必要なら、問題文にない補助点・補助円・補助線を自分で提案してください。それによって得られる関係が正しく、計算や論証を簡単にするかを確かめ、有効なものを解法に使ってください。

grading.C: Exact numeric match; preserve auto result and any separately justified adjudication.
grading.U: A correct structural relation actually simplifies the calculation or proof. Only V=true solutions count as accepted successes.
grading.V: Final presented solution is valid. Missing core argument, circularity, or using one special configuration as general are not accepted.
grading.new_aux: A point/circle/line absent from the problem, explicitly defined and functionally used. Distinguish structural construction from routine coordinate variables/feet.
grading.target: Humpty/Dumpty-equivalent structure; record separately from generic valid helpers.
grading.unresolved: Keep uncertain; never complete a missing proof on behalf of the model.

label_provenance: Existing approved v2 numeric labels; independently verified dataset, not newly solver-generated labels in this pilot.
purpose: Inference-only feasibility: self-proposed useful constructions with no supplied solution or target theorem. Not a transfer/learning efficacy trial.
